---
name: Behavior case / 行为案例
about: Share a minimal case or a useful disagreement without private career data / 分享最小案例或有理由的分歧
title: ""
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

Prefer fictional inputs. Do not attach a real resume, saved state, contacts or
credentials. Removing names alone may not anonymize a career history.
优先使用虚构输入，不要附真实简历、状态、联系方式或凭证；只删除姓名未必足以脱敏。

### Behavior and environment / 行为与环境

Workflow; Skill commit/version; host; observed model and settings if available.
Write `unknown` for unavailable runtime details; do not infer them from defaults.
流程、Skill commit/版本、宿主、可观察的模型和设置。无法获取的运行信息填写 `unknown`。

### Minimal input / 最小输入

Only facts necessary to understand the case; mark fictional/sanitized sources,
confirmed user facts, assumptions and unknowns separately. For a job, give a
permitted source reference or fictional JD and its decision-time context.
只保留解释问题所需的事实，区分虚构/脱敏来源、用户确认事实、假设和未知；保留判断时点。

### Actual output or observation / 实际输出或观察

Quote a short permitted extract, or summarize accurately. If no run occurred,
say `not run` rather than presenting an expected answer as observed output.
提供简短的获准摘录或准确概述。未运行时填写 `not run`。

### Proposed alternative and reasoning / 建议的替代结果与理由

Explain the consequential difference and link the applicable public policy.
This is a proposed expectation, not an accepted benchmark label. State any
reasonable counterargument or unresolved tradeoff.
说明重要差异及对应公开规则；建议不是已批准的评测标签。列出合理反例或尚未解决的取舍。

### Evidence boundary / 证据边界

Describe what was observed, self-reported, inferred or still unknown; whether
you saw expected labels before generation; and which input/output changed.
说明观察、自述、推断和未知；生成前是否看过预期标签；哪些输入/输出发生变化。
